theme.title: Playoff drama
theme.subtitle: 2002 to 2005
theme.recap: Boston shot its way past Philadelphia and erased a big deficit against New Jersey, and Robert Horry stole a Finals game in Detroit.

questions.prompt: In the deciding Game 5 of the 2002 first round against Philadelphia, Paul Pierce scored how many points?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Paul Pierce led the way with 46, on 8-10 shooting from downtown

questions.prompt: Boston erased a big deficit in Game 3 of the 2002 East finals. How many points did it score in the fourth quarter?
questions.context: 2002 East finals · Game 3 · vs New Jersey

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Celtics outscored the Nets 41–16 in the fourth quarter

questions.prompt: Boston made a playoff-record nine threes in one fourth quarter against Philadelphia in 2002. How many did it make in the whole game?
questions.note: 19, nine of them in the fourth quarter.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: hitting an NBA playoff record nine of them in the 4th quarter and 19 in the game

questions.prompt: Robert Horry hit the game-winner in Game 5 of the 2005 Finals. How many points did he score off the bench?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Horry went 5 for 6 from beyond the arc, including the game-winner, and scored 21 points coming off the bench.

questions.prompt: Detroit set a Finals record for the fewest turnovers in a game in 2005. How many did it commit?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Collectively, the Spurs shot 37% and committed 17 turnovers to the Pistons' NBA Finals-record four.
